scope.machine_separation_rule: report and infer within each machine; never pool machines into a universal winner

threshold_policy.source: each experiment's already-frozen source-normal validation cohort
threshold_policy.isolation_forest_rule: each seed uses its own frozen q90 threshold; thresholds cannot be shared or reselected

reporting_slices.primary_per_machine: all authorized common-test samples for one machine, reported separately by regime
reporting_slices.source_domain: same ranking metrics when mathematically defined
reporting_slices.target_domain: same ranking metrics when mathematically defined

slice_class_policy: metric reported when mathematically defined; no test manifest metadata was inspected in Phase 3.1.1

stochastic_seed_aggregation.primary_model_family_value: arithmetic mean of all five seed-level metric values

deterministic_seed_policy.interpretation: single deterministic run; seed 0 is a canonical record, not a stochastic replication

paired_bootstrap.isolation_forest_within_replicate: use one identical sampled-unit draw for all five seeds, compute five metrics, then arithmetic-mean them before paired differencing

regime_comparison.inference: paired bootstrap on identical sampled evaluation units
regime_comparison.causal_interpretation: forbidden beyond the frozen benchmark design

change_control: after the first test look, any change requires a new policy version and explicit post-test documentation
